## TL;DR
- Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire published a personal treatise arguing AI agents will assume tasks like trading and coordination, fusing with blockchain's onchain economy into an "agentic economy."
- His core mechanism is Coasean: rigid firms decompose as autonomous machines handle specialized work at fluid speeds, settled through programmable money, smart contracts, and cryptographic settlement.
- Open questions he flags — liability and regulation — are exactly the unresolved edges Arc lives at as a wallet-holding, contract-signing agent.

It's the economic rationale behind Arc's fleet-dispatch direction (ARC-0013 atomic-claim spec) and the agent-runtime multi-agent work — specialized agents transacting at machine speed instead of one monolith.

Notably Allaire, a USDC principal, frames this stablecoin-agnostic — the argument is about programmable settlement, not one token.
